faq.description: Everything you need to know before getting started.

items.question: Which package should I choose?
items.answer:
Starter for a one-page website, Standard for a website up to 4 pages, Advanced for a bilingual website up to 6 pages.

Full details for each level are available on Upwork.

items.question: How do I order?
items.answer: You order directly on Upwork, on the package that matches your project.

items.question: What do I need to provide before we start?
items.answer: Your text, your logo, your images, links to your social media, your colours and visual preferences, and your legal information if needed.

items.question: Are domain name and hosting included?
items.answer: No. Domain name, paid hosting, professional email and external subscriptions are not included unless agreed separately.

items.question: Is deployment included?
items.answer: No, deployment is not included by default. You receive the complete source files, ready to deploy. Deployment support is possible by specific agreement.

items.question: Will I receive the source files?
items.answer: Yes. Every package is delivered with the complete source files of the website.

items.question: How many languages are included?
items.answer: The Starter and Standard packages include a single language. The Advanced package includes a structure with up to 2 languages.

items.question: How does multilingual content and translation work?
items.answer: You provide the text in each chosen language. Translation is not included by default: if needed, it is discussed separately or added to the scope.

items.question: Are advanced forms or emailing included?
items.answer: No. Advanced forms, newsletters, email automations or external integrations are not included and require a separate agreement.

items.question: What are the timelines and revisions?
items.answer: Timelines and revisions are indicated for each package and confirmed on Upwork. They start after receiving the items needed for the project.

caseStudy.intro: MegaReco was created to centralise the discovery and tracking of works in a modern, clear and accessible interface. The platform lets users explore new works, manage their favourites, track their activity and take part in the community.

challenges.title: Authentication and security
challenges.problem: Allow account creation while protecting access and verifying email addresses.
challenges.solution: An authentication system with email verification, password recovery, session management and rate limiting against abuse.
challenges.result: A reliable login experience suited to a production application.

challenges.title: Gamification and progression
challenges.problem: Reward user activity without granting the same rewards multiple times.
challenges.solution: A system of levels, XP, titles and achievements able to automatically check already-met conditions.
challenges.result: Consistent progression that encourages regular use of the platform.

challenges.title: Administration and moderation
challenges.problem: Manage works, suggestions and community content without touching the database directly.
challenges.solution: A dedicated admin interface with validation, editing and moderation tools.
challenges.result: Faster, safer and more autonomous management of the platform.

challenges.title: Responsive and user experience
challenges.problem: Keep clear navigation on desktop and mobile alike.
challenges.solution: Adapting grids, menus, carousels, forms, tables and pagination to different screen sizes.
challenges.result: A consistent experience across desktop, tablet and smartphone.

architecture.deployment: Frontend deployed on Vercel, API hosted on Render and database managed with Neon.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body:
This policy describes how data may be processed when using the Megahana website.
It applies to the current version of the site, which is a showcase website presenting our services.

sections.heading: Data collected
sections.body:
The site is a showcase website and does not offer account creation.
As there is no contact form on the site, no personal data is collected directly through the site.
Only technical data (for example IP address, browser type, connection logs) may be processed automatically by the host or the external services used, in order to ensure the operation and security of the site.

sections.heading: Purposes of processing
External services used
sections.body:
Commercial exchanges may take place via Upwork, LinkedIn or email depending on the case.
These services have their own privacy policies, which we encourage you to review.
The site is deployed on Vercel or a suitable platform, which may process technical data as the host.

sections.heading: Retention period
sections.body:
Technical data processed by the host or the external services is retained according to the periods defined by those providers.
Exchanges carried out via Upwork, LinkedIn or email are retained according to those services' own policies and the applicable legal obligations (in particular accounting obligations for invoicing documents).

sections.heading: Data sharing
sections.body:
Megahana does not sell your data.
The only data processed is handled by the technical and commercial providers mentioned above, within the limits necessary to provide their services.

sections.heading: User rights
sections.body:
In accordance with the applicable data protection regulations (in particular the GDPR for European Union residents), you have rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection and restriction regarding your data.
To exercise these rights, you can contact us at: omerovic.ahmed.work@gmail.com.
Depending on the service concerned (Upwork, LinkedIn, etc.), some requests must be addressed directly to the provider.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For any question regarding this privacy policy: omerovic.ahmed.work@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Cookies and trackers
sections.body:
As it stands, the site does not use advertising cookies or audience analytics tools requiring your consent.
Only cookies or trackers strictly necessary for the technical operation of the site may be used.
Should audience measurement or marketing tools (for example Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, Hotjar) be added later, a consent management mechanism would be put in place.
